defects.defect: Section 6 says system administrators see the new object through View All Data / Modify All Data. That covers object and record access only; Unique_Key__c gets no profile FLS on deploy, so admins will not see that field. The statement is imprecise, not wrong for the object.
defects.skill_gap: None explicit; spec-format could state that VAD/MAD do not grant field-level security.
